digest.component_or_area: env registry generation and config-ownership gating
propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table contains 4 rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) with no matching function definitions under src/rebar, creating ghost rows that remain unfalsifiable
Ghost rows exempt stale env-read calls from the config-ownership gate validation by name-matching, allowing unowned env reads to silently pass the seam
The gen_env_registry.py module claims invariant "Signatures verified against the current tree" and "no phantom rows" but enforces only tree->table direction, not table->tree
Ghost rows are visible symptom of silent renames: _str_pref's deletion and _gate_str_pref's introduction dropped REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE from docs/env-vars.md without diagnostic
The held-out test at check_config_ownership_heldout.py:96 selects fixtures by dict insertion order on a ghost row, masking test brittleness to row selection order
A root-independent validator must check table rows against DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT definitions, not against scan()'s caller-provided root, to avoid 13-of-13 false positives in synthetic test trees
